mapper.select: SELECT * FROM `chat_message` WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND session_id = #{sessionId} ORDER BY created_at ASC
SELECT DISTINCT session_id FROM `chat_message` WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY session_id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `chat_message` (user_id, session_id, role, content, image_url, created_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{sessionId}, #{role}, #{content}, #{imageUrl}, NOW())
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM `chat_message` WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND session_id = #{sessionId}
